4.text: We anticipate that silver will outperform gold in terms of percentage gains

5.text: Let’s look at some concrete price comparisons.

while the spot price of silver is around $31.
This represents a gold-to-silver ratio of roughly 74.
Historically, this ratio has fluctuated significantly

6.text: If silver’s price increases by 10 percent in 2025, and gold’s price increases by 5 percent
silver will outperform gold by 5 percentage points.
Investing in precious metals isn’t without risk.
Market volatility, economic downturns, and geopolitical events can all impact prices.
Silver is particularly susceptible to fluctuations in industrial demand
while gold’s price is influenced by global economic conditions and investor sentiment.
